items.label: Efficient Performance for All Tasks
items.value: The CHUWI Hi10 X2 Windows tablet is equipped with an Intel Core i3 processor(Beats M3-8100Y/N4120/N4020/N4500), featuring 4 cores and 4 threads with a turbo frequency of up to 3.9GHz. This ensures incredible responsiveness and seamless multitasking, whether you're streaming your favorite shows or working on complex projects, the Hi10 X2 delivers stable and efficient performance. Pre-installed with the latest Windows 11, it offers a more personal, secure, and effortless user experience with automatic updates. Some CHUWI Hi10 X2 tablet runs on Windows 11 Pro and comes with Office.

items.label: 10.1in HD Touchscreen Tablet
items.value: This windows tablet delivers vivid visuals paired with In-Cell 10-point touch for smooth interactions—ideal for work or streaming—while its camera system lets you capture clearly with an 5MP rear AF camera (for photos and videos) and a 2MP front camera (perfect for calls and selfies), and connectivity shines with Micro HDMI, supporting 4K for seamless external display links that are great for presentations or extended workspaces. Full-featured Type-C supports PD fast charge, USB 3.2 data transfer and 4K 60Hz video output.

items.label: Ample Storage for All Your Needs
items.value: With 8GB RAM and 256GB of storage, the Hi10 X2 Windows 11 tablet offers plenty of space to store your videos, audio, and games. This large storage capacity ensures you can keep all your favorite media files, such as e-books, photos, and music, at your fingertips. The combination of ample RAM and storage makes multitasking smooth and efficient, allowing you to run multiple applications without a hitch.

items.label: Chic and Stylish Design
items.value: The CHUWI Hi10 X2 Windows 11 tablet boasts a 0.4-inch ultra-thin full metal chassis, weighing just 1.34lb. Its sleek design not only looks great but also feels comfortable in your hands. The impact-resistant, sturdy body ensures high durability, making it a reliable companion for both indoor and outdoor use. The device's chic appearance and remarkable hands-on feeling make it a stylish choice for those who value both form and function.

items.label: Easy and Reliable Connectivity
items.value: Stay connected with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3, offering faster data transfer speeds, quicker game downloads, and more stable media multitasking. Wi-Fi 6 provides a more powerful and reliable connection, handling multiple devices with ease compared to Wi-Fi 5. This Windows tablet PC includes a stand-equipped protective case. Pair it with the optional magnetic keyboard, and it instantly becomes a Windows laptop.
